# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Buklo Backend — Multi-stage Dockerfile for NestJS services
#
# Usage:
#   docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.service \
#     --build-arg SERVICE_NAME=gateway \
#     -t buklo/gateway:latest .
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ARG NODE_VERSION=20

# ─── Stage 1: Install dependencies ───────────────────────────
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine AS deps

RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9 --activate

WORKDIR /app

# Copy workspace config + lock
COPY pnpm-workspace.yaml pnpm-lock.yaml package.json ./

# Copy all package.json files (for dependency resolution)
COPY packages/ ./packages/

ARG SERVICE_NAME
COPY services/#{SERVICE_NAME}#/package.json ./services/#{SERVICE_NAME}#/

# Install only the service's dependencies (including workspace deps)
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @buklo/service-#{SERVICE_NAME}#...

# ─── Stage 2: Build ──────────────────────────────────────────
FROM deps AS build

COPY tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY packages/ ./packages/
ARG SERVICE_NAME
COPY services/#{SERVICE_NAME}#/ ./services/#{SERVICE_NAME}#/

# Build shared packages first (topological), then the service
RUN pnpm --filter @buklo/service-#{SERVICE_NAME}#... run build

# ─── Stage 3: Production image ───────────────────────────────
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine AS prod

RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9 --activate

WORKDIR /app

# Copy workspace config
COPY --from=build /app/pnpm-workspace.yaml /app/pnpm-lock.yaml /app/package.json ./
COPY --from=build /app/packages/ ./packages/

ARG SERVICE_NAME
COPY --from=build /app/services/#{SERVICE_NAME}#/ ./services/#{SERVICE_NAME}#/

# Install production deps only
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @buklo/service-#{SERVICE_NAME}#... --prod

# Set working directory to the service
WORKDIR /app/services/#{SERVICE_NAME}#

# Health check (override port in docker-compose if needed)
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1

EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"]

# deployment.yml unificado - microservice-gateway-core (Desarrollo)
# Variables de pipeline: #{servicesname}#, #{image}#, #{namespace}#, #{containerregistries}#, #{ambiente}#, #{tag}#, #{reqcpu}#, #{reqmem}#, #{limcpu}#, #{limmem}#
# imagePullSecrets fijo (no token): acr-pull-secret
# Puertos: HTTP 3000 (principal + metrics /api/v1/metrics)
# Health: /api/v1/health
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-secret
  namespace: #{namespace}#
type: Opaque
data:
  # Joi required: CRYPTOP_SECRET_KEY, CRYPTOP_IN_ENCRYPT
  # Runtime crypto: AES_IV (ivEncrypt); CRYPTOP_IN_ENCRYPT sigue por validación Joi
  CRYPTOP_SECRET_KEY: ${REDACTED}
  CRYPTOP_IN_ENCRYPT: OWZlNjM4ZDY2NWUwZjI5MTgxMjM1ZDRkYTBjOTc5OGM=
  AES_IV: OWZlNjM4ZDY2NWUwZjI5MTgxMjM1ZDRkYTBjOTc5OGM=
  REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDACTED}
  ELASTICSEARCH_PASSWORD: ${REDACTED}
  JIRA_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${REDACTED}
  RSA_PASSPHRASE: ${REDACTED}
  ADMIN_API_KEY: ${REDACTED}

stringData:
  # Vacias por ahora — sensibles en Secret
  RSA_PRIVATE_KEY: ""
  RSA_PUBLIC_KEY: ""

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-config
  namespace: #{namespace}#
data:
  REDIS_PORT: "6379"
  REDIS_HOST: "redis-master.common.svc.cluster.local"
  NEST_LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  PORT_REALTIME: "3011"
  HOST_REALTIME: "microservice-realtime-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  EMR_HTTP_PORT: "4010"
  SUBSCRIPTIONS_HTTP_PORT: "4009"
  SURVEYS_HTTP_PORT: "4008"
  TICKETING_HTTP_PORT: "4007"
  PORT_STORAGE: "3005"
  HOST_STORAGE: "microservice-storage-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  PORT_PAYMENT: "3004"
  HOST_PAYMENT: "microservice-payment-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  URLENCODED_EXTENDED: "false"
  URLENCODED_PARAMETER_LIMIT: "50000"
  BODY_PARSER_LIMIT: "50mb"
  # Faltantes vs ENV-VARIABLES-DEV-2026-09-04
  SERVICE_NAME: "gateway"
  # Más conexiones hacia auth/engine para reducir cola bajo concurrencia
  CORS_ORIGINS: "*"
  ELASTICSEARCH_INDEX: "gateway-logs"
  ELASTICSEARCH_URL: "https://elastic-dev.gmontecristo.com/"
  ELASTICSEARCH_USERNAME: "elastic"
  # Discovery — servicios ya desplegados
  HOST_AUTH: "microservice-auth-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_ENGINE: "microservice-engine-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  # Discovery — microservicios monorepo (FQDN al estilo *-service.<ns>.svc.cluster.local)
  HOST_AI_CORE: "microservice-ai-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_TICKETING: "microservice-ticketing-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_SURVEYS: "microservice-surveys-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_SUBSCRIPTIONS: "microservice-subscriptions-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_EMR: "microservice-emr-api-service.desarrollo.svc.cluster.local"
  # info en prod reduce I/O y CPU vs debug
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  MODE: "prod"
  NODE_ENV: "production"
  PORT: "3000"
  PORT_AUTH: "3002"
  PORT_ENGINE: "3001"
  PORT_AI_CORE: "3006"
  PORT_TICKETING: "3007"
  PORT_SURVEYS: "3008"
  PORT_SUBSCRIPTIONS: "3009"
  PORT_EMR: "3010"
  PREFIX: "gmo"
  STRUCTURED_LOGGING: "true"
  TZ: "America/Costa_Rica"
  VERSION: "v1"

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-sa
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#

---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-role
  namespace: #{namespace}#
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods", "services", "endpoints"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["configmaps", "secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list"]
  - apiGroups: ["autoscaling"]
    resources: ["horizontalpodautoscalers"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: ["networking.k8s.io"]
    resources: ["ingresses"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]

---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-rolebinding
  namespace: #{namespace}#
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: #{servicesname}#-sa
    namespace: #{namespace}#
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: #{servicesname}#-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
spec:
  replicas: 1
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: #{servicesname}#
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: #{servicesname}#
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "3000"
        prometheus.io/path: "/api/v1/metrics"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: #{servicesname}#-sa
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: acr-pull-secret
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60

      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: #{servicesname}#
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname

      containers:
        - name: #{servicesname}#
          image: "#{containerregistries}#/#{image}##{ambiente}#:#{tag}#"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 3000
              protocol: TCP

          # Solo envFrom: evita duplicar vars ya definidas en ConfigMap/Secret
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-config
            - secretRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-secret

          volumeMounts:
            - name: logs
              mountPath: /app/logs
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: #{reqcpu}#m
              memory: #{reqmem}#Mi
            limits:
              cpu: #{limcpu}#m
              memory: #{limmem}#Mi
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60
            timeoutSeconds: 5

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 3

          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 20"]

      volumes:
        - name: logs
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-service
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: #{servicesname}#
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 3000

---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-hpa
  namespace: #{namespace}#
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: #{servicesname}#
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 1
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 75
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 200
          periodSeconds: 15
        - type: Pods
          value: 4
          periodSeconds: 15
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 180
      selectPolicy: Min
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 20
          periodSeconds: 60
        - type: Pods
          value: 2
          periodSeconds: 60

---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-ingress
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: "HTTP"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/force-ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "300m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffering: "on"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-connect-timeout: "30"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "240"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "240"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity: "cookie"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity-mode: "persistent"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-name: "route"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-path: "/"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-max-age: "86400"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream: "error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream-tries: "3"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit: "1000"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit-window: "1m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit-connection: "20"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/enable-compression: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/compression-level: "6"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/compression-types: "text/plain,text/css,application/json,application/javascript,text/xml,application/xml,application/xml+rss,text/javascript,application/atom+xml"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-connections: "32"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-timeout: "60s"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-requests: "100"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffer-size: "16k"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffers-number: "8"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-busy-buffers-size: "64k"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - microservice-gateway-api-dev.gmontecristo.com
      secretName: gmontecristo-secret
  rules:
    - host: microservice-gateway-api-dev.gmontecristo.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: #{servicesname}#-service
                port:
                  number: 80

    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit-connection: "20"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/enable-compression: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/compression-level: "6"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/compression-types: "text/plain,text/css,application/json,application/javascript,text/xml,application/xml,application/xml+rss,text/javascript,application/atom+xml"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-connections: "32"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-timeout: "60s"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-requests: "100"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffer-size: "16k"

    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-busy-buffers-size: "64k"
spec:

  rules:

            pathType: Prefix

                port:
                  number: 80

# deployment.yml unificado - microservice-gateway-core (Producción / apuntando a DEV)
# Variables de pipeline: #{servicesname}#, #{image}#, #{namespace}#, #{containerregistries}#, #{ambiente}#, #{tag}#, #{reqcpu}#, #{reqmem}#, #{limcpu}#, #{limmem}#, #{ingress_host}#, #{tls_secret}#, #{image_pull_secret}#, #{node_selector_value}#
# Puertos: HTTP 3000 (principal + metrics /api/v1/metrics)
# Health: /api/v1/health
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-secret
  namespace: #{namespace}#
type: Opaque
data:
  # Joi required: CRYPTOP_SECRET_KEY, CRYPTOP_IN_ENCRYPT
  # Runtime crypto: AES_IV (ivEncrypt); CRYPTOP_IN_ENCRYPT sigue por validación Joi
  CRYPTOP_SECRET_KEY: ${REDACTED}
  CRYPTOP_IN_ENCRYPT: OWZlNjM4ZDY2NWUwZjI5MTgxMjM1ZDRkYTBjOTc5OGM=
  AES_IV: OWZlNjM4ZDY2NWUwZjI5MTgxMjM1ZDRkYTBjOTc5OGM=
  REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDACTED}
  ELASTICSEARCH_PASSWORD: ${REDACTED}
  JIRA_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${REDACTED}
  RSA_PASSPHRASE: ${REDACTED}
  ADMIN_API_KEY: ${REDACTED}

stringData:
  # Vacias por ahora — sensibles en Secret
  RSA_PRIVATE_KEY: ""
  RSA_PUBLIC_KEY: ""

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-config
  namespace: #{namespace}#
data:
  REDIS_PORT: "6379"
  REDIS_HOST: "10.4.0.101"
  NEST_LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  PORT_REALTIME: "3011"
  HOST_REALTIME: "microservice-realtime-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  EMR_HTTP_PORT: "4010"
  SUBSCRIPTIONS_HTTP_PORT: "4009"
  SURVEYS_HTTP_PORT: "4008"
  TICKETING_HTTP_PORT: "4007"
  PORT_STORAGE: "3005"
  HOST_STORAGE: "microservice-storage-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  PORT_PAYMENT: "3004"
  HOST_PAYMENT: "microservice-payment-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  URLENCODED_EXTENDED: "false"
  URLENCODED_PARAMETER_LIMIT: "50000"
  BODY_PARSER_LIMIT: "50mb"
  # Faltantes vs ENV-VARIABLES-DEV-2026-09-04
  SERVICE_NAME: "gateway"
  # Más conexiones hacia auth/engine para reducir cola bajo concurrencia
  CORS_ORIGINS: "*"
  ELASTICSEARCH_INDEX: "gateway-logs"
  ELASTICSEARCH_URL: "https://elastic-metrics-logs.grupomontecristo.com"
  ELASTICSEARCH_USERNAME: "elastic"
  # Discovery — servicios ya desplegados
  HOST_AUTH: "microservice-auth-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_ENGINE: "microservice-engine-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  # Discovery — microservicios monorepo (FQDN al estilo *-service.<ns>.svc.cluster.local)
  HOST_AI_CORE: "microservice-ai-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_TICKETING: "microservice-ticketing-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_SURVEYS: "microservice-surveys-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_SUBSCRIPTIONS: "microservice-subscriptions-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  HOST_EMR: "microservice-emr-api-service.application-services.svc.cluster.local"
  # info en prod reduce I/O y CPU vs debug
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  MODE: "prod"
  NODE_ENV: "production"
  PORT: "3000"
  PORT_AUTH: "3002"
  PORT_ENGINE: "3001"
  PORT_AI_CORE: "3006"
  PORT_TICKETING: "3007"
  PORT_SURVEYS: "3008"
  PORT_SUBSCRIPTIONS: "3009"
  PORT_EMR: "3010"
  PREFIX: "gmo"
  STRUCTURED_LOGGING: "true"
  TZ: "America/Costa_Rica"
  VERSION: "v1"

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-sa
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#

---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-role
  namespace: #{namespace}#
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods", "services", "endpoints"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["configmaps", "secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list"]
  - apiGroups: ["autoscaling"]
    resources: ["horizontalpodautoscalers"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
  - apiGroups: ["networking.k8s.io"]
    resources: ["ingresses"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]

---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-rolebinding
  namespace: #{namespace}#
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: #{servicesname}#-sa
    namespace: #{namespace}#
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: #{servicesname}#-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
spec:
  # 2 réplicas base para repartir carga y reducir latencia bajo concurrencia
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: #{servicesname}#
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: #{servicesname}#
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "3000"
        prometheus.io/path: "/api/v1/metrics"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: #{servicesname}#-sa
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
#      imagePullSecrets:
#       - name: #{image_pull_secret}#

      # En AKS normalmente no se programa en master; si lo ocupas, descomenta:
      # tolerations:
      #   - key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/master"
      #     operator: "Exists"
      #     effect: "NoSchedule"

      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: #{servicesname}#
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname

      containers:
        - name: #{servicesname}#
          image: "#{containerregistries}#/#{image}##{ambiente}#:#{tag}#"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 3000
              protocol: TCP

          # Solo envFrom: evita duplicar vars ya definidas en ConfigMap/Secret
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-config
            - secretRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-secret

          volumeMounts:
            - name: logs
              mountPath: /app/logs
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: #{reqcpu}#m
              memory: #{reqmem}#Mi
            limits:
              cpu: #{limcpu}#m
              memory: #{limmem}#Mi
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60
            timeoutSeconds: 5

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 3

          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 20"]

      volumes:
        - name: logs
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
      nodeSelector:
        agentpool: userpool03

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-service
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
#  annotations:
#    service.beta.kubernetes.io/azure-load-balancer-internal: "true"
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: #{servicesname}#
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 3000

---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-hpa
  namespace: #{namespace}#
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: #{servicesname}#
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 1
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 75
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 200
          periodSeconds: 15
        - type: Pods
          value: 4
          periodSeconds: 15
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 180
      selectPolicy: Min
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 20
          periodSeconds: 60
        - type: Pods
          value: 2
          periodSeconds: 60

---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-ingress
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: "HTTP"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/force-ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "300m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffering: "on"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-connect-timeout: "30"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "240"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "240"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity: "cookie"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity-mode: "persistent"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-name: "route"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-path: "/"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-max-age: "86400"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream: "error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream-tries: "3"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit: "1000"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit-window: "1m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit-connection: "20"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/enable-compression: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/compression-level: "6"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/compression-types: "text/plain,text/css,application/json,application/javascript,text/xml,application/xml,application/xml+rss,text/javascript,application/atom+xml"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-connections: "32"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-timeout: "60s"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-requests: "100"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffer-size: "16k"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffers-number: "8"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-busy-buffers-size: "64k"
spec:
  ingressClassName: internal-ingress
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - microservice-gateway-api.grupomontecristo.com
        - microservice-gateway-api.buklo.dev
      secretName: grupomontecristo-cert-secret
  rules:
    - host: microservice-gateway-api.grupomontecristo.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: #{servicesname}#-service
                port:
                  number: 80
    - host: microservice-gateway-api.buklo.dev
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: #{servicesname}#-service
                port:
                  number: 80

name: Build-buklo-microservice-gateway
